name: Choose the next improvement
description: Select the next intervention according to the strongest observed limitation, then revisit this choice after evaluating it.
decision: what can I change to improve my solution?

children.name: Repair the prediction path
children.description: Restore valid predictions by correcting the failure evidenced in the current execution path.
children.decision: Which observed failure should I repair first?

children.name: Restore model compatibility
children.description: Match the inference implementation to the artifacts used to train the selected model.
children.decision: Which saved training contract is violated at inference?

children.name: Match architecture and weights
children.description: Reconstruct the saved architecture and load the intended weights, checking missing keys and tensor dimensions.

children.name: Restore training preprocessing
children.description: Restore the checkpoint’s training transforms, tokenizer, feature order, and input shape before testing new inference settings.

children.name: Repair dependencies and devices
children.description: Resolve the failing import, artifact path, library API, or device placement and rerun a minimal example.

children.name: Repair silent data flow
children.description: Trace a fixed batch to the first stage that diverges from the intended computation.
children.decision: Where does the first incorrect intermediate output occur?

children.name: Align rows and feature columns
children.description: Join external features and predictions by stable identifiers and assert identical row and column order.

children.name: Correct ensemble arithmetic and routing
children.description: Verify each active member contributes once, the correct fold is loaded, weights are normalized, and the final blend is exported.

children.name: Correct feature and tensor computation
children.description: Inspect intermediate arrays to fix wrong variables, axes, filters, encoders, or feature expressions at the first divergence.

children.name: Repair output semantics and export
children.description: Write the intended prediction array with correct identifiers, labels, sign, activation, and submission schema.

children.name: Isolate the first failing component
children.description: Run the complete path on a tiny representative batch and repair the first failure before enabling another component.

children.name: Improve the comparison
children.description: Choose the observation or experiment design that addresses the current uncertainty.
children.decision: What prevents the next experiment from identifying a real improvement?

children.name: Separate competing explanations
children.description: Recover an interpretable comparison after confounded changes or noisy results.
children.decision: How should I resolve an ambiguous score change?

children.name: Change one factor
children.description: Hold the baseline fixed and ablate or vary one factor to attribute its effect.

children.name: Restore the last verified configuration
children.description: Reproduce the last working configuration before reintroducing rejected changes individually.

children.name: Measure repeated-run variation
children.description: Repeat an unchanged configuration and compare candidate gains with its score distribution rather than a single best run.

children.name: Stop a saturated search
children.description: Freeze the validated best setting when successive probes fail and redirect the next experiment to a different signal or model.

children.name: Choose validation membership
children.description: Choose how examples enter validation before using its scores to guide changes.
children.decision: Which validation partition best represents the prediction setting?

children.name: Preserve target balance
children.description: Stratify folds by class or binned continuous target when examples are otherwise exchangeable.

children.name: Keep related examples together
children.description: Use group-aware folds, deriving defensible groups from metadata or text clusters when needed.

children.name: Validate on the target population
children.description: Construct validation membership around the population expected at test time and keep auxiliary populations out of the scored subset.

children.name: Adjust holdout or fold design
children.description: Compare holdout size or flat versus nested fold construction while preserving an independent evaluation signal.

children.name: Use the actual evaluation metric
children.description: Implement and verify the task metric in validation and early-stopping callbacks with the correct direction and prediction format.

children.name: Check validation-to-test agreement
children.description: Compare paired validation and external evaluation scores across existing configurations and investigate mismatched preprocessing or population coverage before further selection.

children.name: Change the learning information
children.description: Choose whether to alter training examples, input representation, or retained features.
children.decision: Which part of the available information should I change next?

children.name: Change training examples
children.description: Choose a data intervention based on label quality, distribution mismatch, and available extra examples.
children.decision: How should the training sample population change?

children.name: Filter or deduplicate examples
children.description: Ablate low-quality, overlapping, or mismatched examples while retaining enough representative training data.

children.name: Reweight observed examples
children.description: Tune sample or class weights, including down-weighting, against the actual validation metric.

children.name: Generate synthetic training examples
children.description: Test mixup, interpolation, or minority oversampling with validation examples excluded from synthesis.

children.name: Add auxiliary labeled examples
children.description: Introduce compatible external labeled data, optionally in a separate pretraining stage before clean-data fine-tuning.

children.name: Use pseudo-labeled examples
children.description: Train a candidate with pseudo-labels from unlabeled examples and measure its standalone and marginal ensemble value.

children.name: Alter training augmentation
children.description: Test the strength or type of training-time noise, image transforms, or temporal masking while holding the evaluation pipeline fixed.

children.name: Choose a replacement representation
children.description: Choose an input representation justified by the structure of the raw data.
children.decision: Which representation should I test for the missing signal?

children.name: Summarize repeated observations
children.description: Choose one feature family to add or simplify for repeated records.
children.decision: Which information is missing from the current entity representation?

children.name: Aggregate entity histories
children.description: Compare a compact set of entity-level summary statistics with richer summaries of the same records.

children.name: Encode temporal changes
children.description: Add lag differences, ratios, recent-history windows, or timestamp-derived features in chronological order.

children.name: Encode domain interactions
children.description: Test domain-motivated differences, ratios, or interactions between related features.

children.name: Change numeric or categorical preprocessing
children.description: Compare native handling with imputation, encoding, scaling, rounding, or precision changes on the same inputs.

children.name: Encode language content
children.description: Select a text representation according to the information absent from the existing feature set.
children.decision: Which text representation should be added or substituted?

children.name: Change text preparation
children.description: Ablate cleaning, spelling correction, cropping, metadata prompts, or sequence formatting with compatible model artifacts.

children.name: Use lexical or latent text features
children.description: Tune n-gram counts or TF-IDF and their topic or low-rank decompositions as a feature block.

children.name: Use structural and linguistic features
children.description: Add document, paragraph, sentence, readability, spelling, or metadata statistics and ablate the block.

children.name: Use frozen pretrained embeddings
children.description: Extract and cache matched pretrained representations as downstream model features, comparing source models and dimensionality.

children.name: Use cross-fitted prediction features
children.description: Generate out-of-fold auxiliary predictions or leakage-safe retrieval features and align them with downstream training rows.

children.name: Preserve spatial or temporal structure
children.description: Select a representation intervention supported by the checkpoint and the signal semantics.
children.decision: Which aspect of the spatial or temporal input should change?

children.name: Change image resolution
children.description: Sweep input resolution around the training resolution while holding checkpoints and aggregation fixed.

children.name: Change temporal window or spatial crop
children.description: Test context length or crop offset against the time span and region covered by the label.

children.name: Change time-frequency representation
children.description: Test FFT, hop, mel, sampling, rendering, or frequency-resolution settings with compatible trained models.

children.name: Change filtering or normalization
children.description: Test signal clipping, bandpass filtering, log scaling, or per-sample normalization against the saved preprocessing baseline.

children.name: Change modalities or channel layout
children.description: Ablate raw-signal, spectral, derived-channel, or reshaped input branches to measure the information each contributes.

children.name: Choose feature retention
children.description: Choose the pruning mechanism that matches the suspected source of redundant or missing signal.
children.decision: How should I reduce or refresh the feature set?

children.name: Tune the importance cutoff
children.description: Sweep the retained fraction or count of ranked features on fixed folds instead of accepting an arbitrary cap.

children.name: Ablate whole feature blocks
children.description: Remove or restore one coherent feature family and compare its marginal validation contribution.

children.name: Refit feature selection without leakage
children.description: Recompute importance or selection inside training folds after changing feature sources and persist the selected schema.

children.name: Change the fitted predictor
children.description: Choose a model-side intervention while keeping a trustworthy evaluation path.
children.decision: Which part of the predictor should I replace or retune?

children.name: Choose the predictor family
children.description: Select a replacement family or capacity rather than changing several modeling assumptions at once.
children.decision: What kind of predictor change addresses the current limitation?

children.name: Replace the pretrained backbone
children.description: Compare a different pretrained family, capacity, or domain-pretrained backbone with matching weights and preprocessing.

children.name: Replace the tabular learner
children.description: Compare tree-boosting libraries, boosting modes, classical regressors, or neural learners on the same validated inputs.

children.name: Change pooling or the prediction head
children.description: Test attention, pooling, shared versus separate heads, normalization, or auxiliary outputs with a consistently trained checkpoint.

children.name: Change feature fusion
children.description: Compare concatenation, summation, or learned fusion of aligned modality embeddings with a correspondingly trained head.

children.name: Choose the training signal
children.description: Align the fitted signal with the evaluation semantics without using held-out labels in target construction.
children.decision: How should the objective or target encoding change?

children.name: Align the loss or prediction formulation
children.description: Compare regression, classification, ordinal, pairwise, or distributional objectives and tune their differentiable implementation.

children.name: Center or rescale regression targets
children.description: Compare global versus fold-local target centering or scalar transformations with consistent inverse transforms.

children.name: Choose the training adjustment
children.description: Choose one coupled parameter family based on convergence and generalization evidence.
children.decision: Which training limitation is visible in the current fit?

children.name: Tune tree structure
children.description: Sweep depth, leaf count, and minimum child size to balance underfitting and overfitting.

children.name: Tune regularization and subsampling
children.description: Adjust penalties, dropout, or row and column subsampling while keeping the data and convergence budget comparable.

children.name: Tune learning rate and optimizer
children.description: Compare learning rates, schedules, or optimizers and scale the training budget when step size changes.

children.name: Tune training duration and stopping
children.description: Adjust rounds, epochs, patience, or stopping checkpoints using the intended validation metric.

children.name: Select a compatible trained checkpoint
children.description: Compare saved folds, training stages, or snapshots under identical inference and postprocessing settings.

children.name: Change how predictors are combined
children.description: Choose between membership, aggregation, and repeated inference on fixed base predictions.
children.decision: Which ensemble intervention should I test next?

children.name: Choose ensemble membership
children.description: Use marginal contribution rather than standalone quality alone to decide inclusion.
children.decision: How should the current member set change?

children.name: Add a complementary predictor
children.description: Introduce one candidate with a different architecture, training recipe, target, or representation and test its marginal contribution.

children.name: Prune or substitute members
children.description: Ablate one member or substitute one candidate in a fixed ensemble slot, keeping the remaining weights and inputs controlled.

children.name: Compare a single predictor with the blend
children.description: Evaluate the strongest members alone against the full blend to establish whether diversity earns its added complexity.

children.name: Change the number of fold checkpoints
children.description: Add or remove fold checkpoints incrementally and compare against the best single fold with unchanged preprocessing.

children.name: Average independent training seeds
children.description: Average predictions from independently trained seeds and stop adding runs when their marginal benefit disappears.

children.name: Choose the combination rule
children.description: Choose between direct averaging, transformed averaging, and a fitted second stage.
children.decision: What combination rule fits the available prediction evidence?

children.name: Average predictions uniformly
children.description: Use an equal-weight average as a baseline or restore it when tuned weights do not generalize.

children.name: Tune constrained blend weights
children.description: Optimize or coarsely sweep member weights on aligned validation predictions and recheck after changing any member.

children.name: Rank-normalize before blending
children.description: Compare rank-transformed member outputs with raw-score averaging when the metric depends on ordering.

children.name: Choose probability-space or logit-space averaging
children.description: Compare averaging probabilities with averaging logits or transformed probabilities followed by normalization.

children.name: Fit a cross-validated meta-learner
children.description: Fit and validate a regularized second-stage model on cross-fitted base predictions, refitting it when its inputs change.

children.name: Choose repeated inference views
children.description: Choose a test-time averaging scheme appropriate to the input symmetry and checkpoint behavior.
children.decision: Which label-preserving inference variation is supported?

children.name: Average deterministic symmetry views
children.description: Compare original predictions with flip or domain-specific mirror predictions only where the label semantics permit the symmetry.

children.name: Average crops or resolutions
children.description: Average matched predictions across justified crops, temporal windows, or resolutions.

children.name: Average stochastic inference passes
children.description: Explicitly enable and test stochastic dropout or augmentation passes instead of assuming an inference config change activates them.

children.name: Average model weights
children.description: Evaluate stochastic weight averaging of compatible training snapshots as an alternative to repeated prediction passes.

children.name: Change prediction interpretation
children.description: Choose a postprocessing intervention only after the underlying prediction pipeline is valid.
children.decision: Which output adjustment matches the observed error and metric?

children.name: Map outputs to discrete targets
children.description: Choose the thresholding method based on label support and available calibration evidence.
children.decision: Which discretization rule should convert the continuous predictions?

children.name: Optimize global thresholds
children.description: Fit global ordinal cutpoints on held-out predictions and compare with plain rounding after each model change.

children.name: Match a supported label distribution
children.description: Compare quantile or frequency-based mapping with fixed thresholds when a transferable target distribution is supported.

children.name: Use group or target-specific cutpoints
children.description: Fit separate cutpoints only for groups or output columns with enough independent calibration data.

children.name: Handle degenerate ties explicitly
children.description: Preserve a valid ordering when binning creates constant columns or excessive ties, testing a continuous fallback or supported tie handling.

children.name: Correct continuous outputs
children.description: Choose a correction appropriate to continuous, probability, or subgroup errors.
children.decision: Which observed calibration discrepancy should be adjusted?

children.name: Correct location or scale bias
children.description: Test a held-out additive offset, reference-relative correction, or bounded scaling and retain it only if the target metric improves.

children.name: Calibrate class probabilities
children.description: Test class-specific multipliers or calibration followed by valid per-row probability normalization.

children.name: Apply a gated auxiliary correction
children.description: Use validated auxiliary class outputs, metadata rules, or subgroup masks to correct only the supported predictions.

children.name: Make a viable experiment cheaper
children.description: Preserve the effective prediction computation while reducing the resource bottleneck.
children.decision: Which measured bottleneck should I remove?

children.name: Reduce peak memory
children.description: Choose a memory intervention based on allocations rather than changing the model blindly.
children.decision: What dominates peak memory in the failing stage?

children.name: Process rows in chunks
children.description: Run feature construction or inference in identifier-preserving chunks and concatenate the results in the original order.

children.name: Release completed stages
children.description: Load models sequentially and release tensors, sessions, or intermediate frames once their outputs are saved.

children.name: Reduce batch or precision footprint
children.description: Tune inference batch size, dynamic padding, or precision and compare predictions to a fixed full-precision reference.

children.name: Cache stable intermediate artifacts
children.description: Persist features, out-of-fold predictions, or model snapshots with identifiers and configuration provenance to avoid recomputation.

children.name: Use a reduced development run
children.description: Use a centralized development configuration for fewer rows, folds, or rounds, then explicitly restore the full intended run.

children.name: Consolidate configuration and preserve outputs
children.description: Centralize model manifests and reusable inference functions, checking prediction equivalence before removing old paths.

children.name: Replace a slow computation with an equivalent implementation
children.description: Benchmark a vectorized, GPU, or alternative backend against the current implementation on fixed inputs.

unassigned.reason: Exploratory profiling of the data only; no change to the solution is specified.
Progress-bar import and display bookkeeping; no predictive or execution-correctness change is specified.
